text_block_list.text:
"Summer Training Camp" to hone their skills
begins today—
However...
—Symboli Rudolf was still at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Hishi Amazon, Fuji Kiseki.
Let's hear your report.
choice_data_list: (That's... the dorm leaders of Miura Dorm and Ritto Dorm.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All the Miho girls took off on the earlier flight.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Ritto Dorm has completely departed as well,
save for those who reported feeling unwell this morning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Is care for those feeling unwell being handled according to plan?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, I've left it in the care of the teachers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everything is in order, then.
Good work. You two may head out as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, don't be late yourself, President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then let's finish our final checks
and head out.
choice_data_list: So you won't be taking command from the front lines.
So you're not taking command from the front lines, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove is probably carrying it out
to absolute perfection right about now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'd also like to check in on the girl who unfortunately had to sit out.
choice_data_list: Still, won't you be late for the start?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have a secret plan for that.
By the way, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you hold an admiration
for the sound of the word "Supercar"?
choice_data_list: (I have a bad feeling about this for some reason...)

text_block_list.text: That premonition proved right—
(VROOM VRRROOOOM!! ...SKRRRRT!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for the ride, Maruzensky.
Thanks to you, I made it safely before start time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
I really enjoyed the drive♪
Symboli Rudolf's secret plan was to speed all the way to the training camp in Maruzensky's beloved car...
I'd heard the rumors, but Maruzensky's driving style was... a little, or rather, a lot on the extreme runaway side.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: By the way, Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer looks pretty worn out.
Are they going to be alright?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No doubt they were simply intoxicated
by your technique.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"How about that, Trainer-kun? Maruzensky's
driving is thrilling beyond compare, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it pleased you,
I could arrange for her on the return trip as well—

At any rate,
the summer training camp had begun...!
